priorityList.notes: Dark Sacrifice, Undead only, once you are under 70% mana and still healthy: it turns your own health into mana over 15 seconds, plus your Spirit, and its 10 minute cooldown makes it once a fight.
Penance on cooldown, on whoever is hurt: three heals one second apart for one cast every 12 seconds, cheap for all it heals.

On the tank once he is hurt and Weakened Soul is off him, while your mana keeps pace with the fight: it soaks the next hit and costs a warrior no rage. Cast the top rank at 60; while leveling, some races keep the older rank for a few levels after a new one arrives. Once you have Renewed Hope, the Weakened Soul it leaves makes your next heals on him crit more, and with Divine Aegis every one of those crits leaves a shield.
Keep Renew on the tank all fight; at 60 that means rank 7 or higher.
Flash Heal at the top rank on a tank who is really low, as long as your mana keeps up with the fight: the fast heal, and the dear one. Once you are behind, Greater Heal started early is the save.
Flash Heal on a party member about to die, as long as your mana is not far behind the fight.
Prayer of Healing once three of your four party members are under 85%: it heals the target and the target's whole party. Rank 4 is the top rank a trainer teaches.
Greater Heal at the top rank as the tank's filler at 60: he takes the big hits, so the big heal goes on him.

Heal rank 1 on the tank through 35 (36 as an Undead) and rank 3 from 36, until you learn Greater Heal at 40: rank 1 keeps your whole healing bonus until 33 and heals the most for its mana, and rank 4 costs more mana than its extra healing is worth.
Lesser Heal rank 3 on the tank until you learn Heal at 16: your shield and Renew alone will not keep him up.
On a party member missing a third of their health, since once you have higher ranks it keeps most of your healing bonus for far less mana.

Lesser Heal is the party's small top-up for little mana before 40. From 40 on, leave it off your bars for good: by your late forties it has lost your healing bonus, and every cast costs regeneration you need.
When your mana falls behind the fight, only on a tank under 50%, so it waits for a deeper hole.
When your mana falls behind the fight, only on a party member under 35%, so it waits for a deeper hole too.
